audit.why: Early lane favors Viktor (Azir weakest pre-6 laner), mid even, teamfights favor whoever hits range windows; 57.02% WR at 1517 games supports Viktor-favored read. EVEN/5.5 rating is defensible but chart should reflect Viktor edge.
Spikes correct: E+Q levels 3-5, Azir window at 6 (Emperor's Divide + Shuffle), Viktor first item and 2+ items. Matches packet levelChart (Viktor all rows except First item).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text calls Viktor E 'Death Ray'; real name is Hextech Ray (kit E text). Cooldowns field has no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: E fires 'a Hextech Ray'. Azir E (Shifting Sands) 22s rank 1 / 16s max is his only dash+shield; Viktor W 17s rank 1; Viktor R 120s.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Hextech Ray; cooldowns rewritten with real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[] reads Viktor x5, Azir, Viktor — two answers to the same row.
audit.why: Content layer and packet levelChart agree; full layer carries a blanket 'Skill'. Moving side alone per the chart rule (win[N] already correct), with whys rewritten to match verdicts.
audit.corrected: Seven side edits + why rewrites + ratings.

edits.before: Once you have E (Death Ray) plus one point in Q, you win every extended trade: E carves his soldiers' minions and his face while your Siphon Power shield eats his soldier autos. Azir is one of the weakest early laners in the game and can't punch back through your poke.
edits.after: Once you have E (Hextech Ray) plus one point in Q, you win every extended trade: E carves his soldiers' minions and his face while your Siphon Power shield eats his soldier autos. Azir is one of the weakest early laners in the game and can't punch back through your poke.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Azir wins by poking with soldiers at a range you can't answer, then flipping a fight at 6 with Emperor's Divide.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. It governs your forward steps. - W Gravity Field spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: 22s at rank 1, 16s maxed — his only dash and shield. Once he burns it, you own a long window to step up and trade. - Your W Gravity Field is 17s at rank 1 — spent on poke, your anti-dive is gone. - Hold the 120s R for real fights.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Siphon Power is a 9s cooldown at rank 1 — cast it as his soldier winds up so the shield eats the poke, then land the empowered auto.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Azir shoves back with soldiers the second you leave — a failed roam trades your scaling lead away for his free plates.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: You win level 1: his soldier passive needs stacked autos he can't land, and your Q-shield trade walks away free.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online and you win: the laser farms and pokes in one cast while his fragile soldier harass loses the exchange.

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: Full kit and still yours: you out-range his whole soldier line with E and W punishes any greedy soldier step-up.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours — E max shoves and pokes him off farm before he has any all-in tool. Bank Manaflow quietly.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Even at 6 you win straight fights: Chaos Storm and Gravity Field out-value his ult — just respect the Shuffle.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: Azir's edge: his Shuffle-plus-wall combo can flip one fight or peel a gank — give him this window, not a death.

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two items and it's yours again: upgraded ult and E line dominate his short-range soldier skirmishes and clumps.
